name: A Donation of Wool
summary: Ironforge is accepting wool cloth donations to support its stores. Sixty pieces earn full recognition for your generosity.

sections.title: Wool Stores
sections.body: Ironforge needs sixty pieces of wool cloth from you. Its stores need only that amount from you, while others are expected to contribute enough to support the drive.

faq.q: How much wool does Ironforge need from me?
faq.answer: Ironforge asks you for sixty pieces of wool cloth.

faq.q: What do I get for donating wool?
faq.answer: Donating sixty pieces of wool cloth earns you full recognition from Ironforge for your generosity.
Ironforge is gathering wool cloth to support its stores.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, your wool donation earns recognition from Ironforge.
